newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS DOWN IN KERB, SEEN WEAK.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTANI RUPEE ENDS DOWN IN KERB, SEEN WEAK.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.02 down at 41.30 to the dollar on Wednesday as dollar demand outstripped supply, dealers said.

"The current level of the U.S currency is considered attractive and demand for the dollar outpaced supply," dealer Abdul Latif said. "There are fears of rupee devaluation in the near term and speculators are building up their positions.
The central bank rate, unchanged since July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended steady at 2.0 percent.
